title: RecipeTin's White Christmas Rocky Road
ingredients: 500g white chocolate melts or chopped block
steps: Grease a 20cm square pan with butter and line with baking paper, leaving an overhang.
Reserve 8 nice glacé cherries and finely chop 1 tablespoon of the toasted pistachios.
Place chocolate and oil in a bowl, microwaving in 30-second bursts until melted and smooth.
Stir marshmallows, pistachios, cherries, and coconut into the melted chocolate thoroughly.
Pour into the prepared pan, top with reserved cherries and pistachios, then chill for 3 hours.
